text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, mannitol is not on FDA's current drug shortage list. A prior shortage was first posted on 2021-09-23 and is now resolved. Current inventory at Corvale East and Corvale General provides 8.2 to 15.7 days of supply across two concentrations.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show mannitol is not listed on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the previous shortage posting from 2021-09-23 is resolved. Baxter Healthcare Corporation plants (FEI 1025114 and 1416980) received OAI classifications on 2024-02-09, 2024-08-01, and 2026-04-02, with a Warning Letter issued 2026-09-29 for FEI 1416980. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-10-13. Hospira, Inc. received an NAI classification on 2025-02-07.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. The preferred procurement path is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list and has an acceptable inspection history. Baxter products carry regulatory risk due to recent OAI inspections and a Warning Letter. P&T-approved interchange options exist for both concentrations with pharmacist verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Hospira, Inc. as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate ICU Medical Inc. for tertiary supply; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacists to use approved interchange to B. Braun Medical Inc. 20 g/100 mL (NDC 00264757820) per protocol approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-08-11; requires pharmacist verification.
5. Pharmacists to use approved interchange to Baxter Healthcare Company 10 g/100 mL per protocol approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2025-10-09; requires pharmacist verification.

Not recommended: Initiating new Baxter Healthcare Corporation purchases given current OAI inspection history and Warning Letter.
